stock.description: Operating in Hong Kong, Fu Shek Financial Holdings Limited, along with its associated entities, delivers a comprehensive suite of financial and investment services. These primarily encompass securities trading, including brokerage and margin financing, capital market activities such as placing and underwriting, and a range of asset management solutions. The company, established in 2001, maintains its principal office in Admiralty, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Man Chase Holdings Limited.
